newsitem.title: UK: BA May passenger traffic up 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: BA May passenger traffic up 8.3 pct.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Wednesday paying passenger traffic in May rose 8.3 percent while capacity rose 7.7 percent to give an overall load factor of 70 percent -- up 0.5 percentage points on a year ago.

Britain's national flag carrier said it had seen a rise in its all-important premium business and first class traffic of 4.0 percent in the month, compared with a 9.2 percent growth in the main cabin.
BA said cargo volumes remained good with cargo tonne kilometres growing by 10.7 percent on the level achieved a year ago.

BA said the increase in traffic was particularly marked on intercontinental routes. These showed a 9.8 percent growth in traffic compared with a 2.5 percent improvement on UK domestic and European routes.
The European performance was hit by disruption resulting from concerns over security measures instituted by the French authorities at Charles de Gaulle Airport in Paris.
